title: 49ers star edge rusher Nick Bosa suffered a calf injury and could miss next week’s game vs. the Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers star edge rusher Nick Bosa suffered a calf injury and could miss next week’s game vs. the Broncos
sources.description: According to ESPN’s lead league insider Adam Schefter, 49ers five-time Pro Bowl defensive end Nick Bosa suffered a calf injury during practice this week and is expected to miss a “few weeks,” and the team is determining whether Bosa will land on the injured reserve or not.
